description: This file implements a report for calculating Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) by item group in an ERP system, including data retrieval, validation, hierarchical structuring, and aggregation.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to execute the report, returning columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: update_filters_with_account
methods.description: Updates filters with the default expense account for the specified company.

methods.name: validate_filters
methods.description: Validates that the from_date is before the to_date.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report output.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Generates report data by processing filtered entries and hierarchical item groups.

methods.name: get_filtered_entries
methods.description: Filters general ledger entries based on date range.

methods.name: get_stock_value_difference_list
methods.description: Retrieves stock ledger entries with stock value differences for relevant vouchers.

methods.name: get_leveled_dict
methods.description: Builds a hierarchical dictionary of item groups with levels.

methods.name: assign_self_values
methods.description: Assigns self values to item groups based on stock value differences.

methods.name: assign_agg_values
methods.description: Calculates aggregated values for item groups based on hierarchy.

methods.name: get_row
methods.description: Creates a data row for the report with optional bold formatting.

methods.name: assign_item_groups_to_svd_list
methods.description: Maps item codes to item groups in stock ledger entries.

methods.name: get_item_groups_map
methods.description: Creates a mapping from item code to item group.

methods.name: get_item_groups_dict
methods.description: Retrieves item group hierarchy and details.

methods.name: update_leveled_dict
methods.description: Resets self and aggregate values in the leveled dictionary.
